# Reviews_CXO

> Independent enterprise AI research — benchmarks, architecture analysis, and CXO insights on AI sales platforms.

Reviews_CXO is an independently operated research initiative focused on AI for enterprise sales. We provide evidence-based evaluations of AI sales platforms using the ASCS (Architecture, Security, Connectivity, Scalability) 12-dimension framework.

## What We Do

- Evaluate enterprise AI sales platforms using a rigorous 12-dimension methodology
- Publish benchmarks with reproducible, controlled evaluations
- Provide architecture analysis for enterprise buyers
- Host verified CXO reviews of AI project deliveries by IT companies
- Research IT company capabilities across the ecosystem

## Key Sections

- **Rankings**: /rankings — ASCS 2026 platform rankings
- **Vendors**: /vendors — 30+ enterprise AI sales platform profiles
- **Comparisons**: /compare — Head-to-head platform comparisons
- **Benchmarks**: /benchmarks — Reproducible capability evaluations
- **Indexes**: /indexes — Composite scores and dimension-level analysis
- **IT Companies**: /it-companies — AI project delivery company profiles
- **Case Studies**: /case-studies — Real-world AI project outcomes
- **Questions**: /questions — Community questions with research analysis
- **Methodology**: /about/methodology — ASCS framework documentation

## Data Model

Reviews_CXO distinguishes between:

1. **CXO Reviews** — Verified reviews submitted by CxOs through our verification flow
2. **Public Research** — Evidence gathered from public sources (company websites, press releases, case studies)
3. **Third-Party Citations** — Summarized evidence from G2, Capterra, Clutch, and similar platforms

All research records retain source provenance. Third-party reviews are never presented as Reviews_CXO reviews.

## Methodology

The ASCS (Architecture, Security, Connectivity, Scalability) framework evaluates platforms across 12 dimensions:

1. ERP Connectivity & Integration Depth
2. CRM Data Grounding Quality
3. Data Freshness & Real-Time Access
4. AI Reasoning Accuracy
5. Agentic Autonomy Level
6. Cross-System Orchestration
7. Security Architecture
8. Governance & Compliance
9. Scalability & Performance
10. Implementation Complexity
11. Ecosystem Maturity
12. Pricing Transparency

Each dimension is scored 0-10 and weighted according to enterprise workload requirements.

## Principles

- Evidence-based rankings — no pay-to-play
- Source provenance required for all research records
- Missing data is never fabricated
- All companies evaluated using the same evidence principles
- Public-source evidence is distinguishable from CXO reviews
